description: This file defines a utility class 'LibraryLoader' within the 'Utils' namespace, which manages dynamic library loading and object creation via dlopen/dlsym. It includes methods for loading shared libraries and creating shared pointers to objects from those libraries, with error handling.

classes.name: LibraryLoader
classes.description: A class that handles dynamic loading of shared libraries and creation of objects from them.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads a shared library from a specified path and sets an error message if loading fails.

methods.name: CreateShared
methods.description: Creates a shared pointer to an object of type T by invoking a factory function 'Create' from the loaded library.
